english: Hmm, so this is where you've been hanging out lately?
No mistake. Shall I call them out?
Since we're here, shall we surprise them?
Understood.
//Battle map: Akihabara (daytime)\n//Mii and Kei suddenly appear with many grunts.
Let's plaaay!
//Dejiko appears.
Cut it out, nyo!! You're hurting business, nyo!!
The customer is king! It's Mii!
Is this an attack, nyo!!\nThink about the time and place, nyo!!
I'd get scolded for playing at night~?
Don't conveniently act like a kid, nyo!\nAnd a king getting scolded, nyo!!\nWho'd even scold you, nyo!
Ahaha! Look, Kei-chan!!\nThat's what a perfect comeback looks like!
Incomprehensible.
Study up. I don't wanna be the tsukkomi.
Whatever, just go home, nyo.
If you won't play with me, I'll rampage here!
You're gonna rampage either way, nyo!
Plaaay plaaay plaaay!!
Oh, right.\nIf you play with me, I'll tell you something good!
Something good? Like what, nyo?
Don't you wanna know\nwhat the Darks are up to?
The Darks, nyo?
//Player deployment.
You know what the black ones are up to?
Now that's interesting!
Aren't they your subordinates?
Wh-!? Don't all come out at once, nyo!?
Okay, let's play a game.\nIf you clear it all, I'll tell you.
A game... I wonder if it's fair?\nI can't trust it, but.
Refusing and angering her wouldn't be good, I think?
Games are my specialty,\nso I might be useful!
Can't stay quiet hearing about games!
It's the club members' specialty!
What game are we playing?
Let's start with an easy one.\nTry beating these guys\nunder the conditions Mii and Kei-chan give!
//The grunts placed on Mii's orders vanish. 5 new grunts appear in front.
Just beat these 5?
That's right!\nThe first condition:\nbeat all of these!
What's that? Isn't it too easy?
Louise-san! Don't say that -\nwhat if she makes it harder, desu~!
The first one's on the house!
Umm... there are 5 questions total,\nand clear them all within\n20 turns total!
Oh, right -\nthe bandaged big bro over there\ncan't get taken out!
Wh-what!?\nM-me...?
//Battle start.\n//Victory condition: defeat the 5 in order of highest max HP.
Bzzt! No good!\nGame over!
//Game over.
Stage 1 clear!\nLike a practice level!
Um, I think I've got the rules down!
Kei-chan, you make stage 2!
Huh? I hadn't anticipated this?
Just do it!
Understood.\nCreating questions. Selecting difficulty. Decided.
Stage 2, set.
//5 grunts appear in front.
The next 5 will attack one target.\nWipe them out without letting the target be attacked.\nIf the target is attacked even once, you fail.
The target is...\nthe bandaged big bro!
M-me...\nSo that's what this was...\n*sigh*...
//Battle start.\n//Victory condition: clear by getting all 5 below 30%. Once skillfully below 30%, they're removed from the map.
Attack on the target confirmed. Game over.
//Game over.
Mission complete.\nMii, what next?
Maybe make it a bit harder?
Too simple is no good either.
Though asking for harder is weird too.
Then let's see your serious side!\nStage 3 will be thiiis!
//1 grunt appears in front.
Beat this one!\nIt's pretty strong, so watch\nyour remaining turns!
A power contest this time!\nAll right, let's go all out!
My turn, maybe?
//Battle start.\n//Victory condition: defeat the grunt in 3 turns. It heals when damaged, uses full evasion or abilities, something like that? Please adjust.
Bzzt! No good!\nGame over!
//Game over.
Stage 3 clear!\nStill got room to spare?
This hardly counts as a hard question.
All right, Kei-chan!\nTime to give them trouble!
Trouble? Recognized as raising the difficulty.\nUnderstood. Raising the setting.
Stage 4, set.
//2 grunts appear in front.
Defeat the next 2.\nHowever, they will flee at full speed.
Getting pretty hard, kana? Kana?
And there's a tough-looking one and a weak-looking one.\nWhat a pain!!
//Battle start.\n//Victory condition: clear by getting both to 10% or below in 2 turns. Once skillfully at 10% or below, they're removed from the map.
Clear conditions unmet.\nGame over.
//Game over.
Mission complete.\nMii, what next?
Then let's do a super-hard one last!\nUmm, umm, thiiis one!
//Grunts deployed like a normal battle.
Hm? Fight normally, you mean?
In a way that's the easiest.
Ahaha!\nIs it~?

//Victory conditions displayed. Each grunt has its own clear condition: (1) defeat within N turns, (2) reduce HP to N% or below (cannot defeat), (3) defeat only after grunts with higher max HP are gone, etc.
Sooo, are the remaining turns okay~?\nIt's the last one, but Kei-chan, anything to add?
Let's raise the difficulty further.\nWe'll join the attack midway.
Now that's interesting! Let's do it!
We can't lose, you know~.
Yes.
Yes, let's do our best!
I'm sorry, I'm sorry…\nI'll do my best to run away…
W-whoa… e-everyone, keep your spirits up!\nLet's do our best! Hiyahh!
There's something refreshing about how readily Soniko throws herself in…
Clear this stage and I'll tell you what I know.\nAlrighty, stage 5 staaart!!
Bzzzt! No good!\nGame over!
Stipulated conditions confirmed as met.\nCommencing action.
Nyo!! We've got to hurry, nyo!!
I'm the anti-stall character, nyu.
That name takes me back…
How's that?!
Ooh~! We cleared everything!
Wonderful work, everyone!
Kei-chan, there wasn't any cheating, was there?
No unauthorized conduct confirmed.\nMission complete.
Yeahh! How's that for ya!
Please - that was a piece of cake!
Did it work? Hoooray!
Five turns gone!\nKeep it up~! Kyahaha!
Ten turns elapsed, confirmed.\nTen turns remain.
Five turns left!\nC'mon, hurry hurry~! Kyahaha!
As promised - disclose what you know about those black ones!
Sure~. That was pretty fun, after all!
Talking face-to-face like this\nfeels strange, though…
The fact we can talk things out is a good thing!
Better than not being able to, I suppose.
Okay, Kei-chan, explanation duty's all yours~.
Acknowledged.
Currently, with Dark Remu at their center,\nthe Dark Army is carrying out\na large-scale operation.
Hold on a moment.\nThis 'Dark' whatever -\nis that their official name?
I came up with it myself!\nEasy to understand, right~?
I want to get one thing straight:\nyou didn't create those black ones,\nor command them - right?
One of 'em's a little different, but\nI dunno about the rest!
Different, how?
Dark Remu was captured and used by me\nfor a certain purpose.\nShe has since escaped and is now acting on her own.
So you'd sealed away my 'dream power'?
Further disclosure of information\nregarding Dark Remu has not been authorized.
Forget that boring stuff -\nlet's talk about the Dark Army!
The Dark Army split into three groups\nand went off to attack somewhere, apparently!
Three groups?
More importantly - where's 'somewhere'!?
Hinamizawa, Black Fund HQ,\nand the Gamers main store - three locations.
Hinamizawa…!
Black Fund HQ - you don't mean!
No 'you don't mean' about it - they're after Gustave, obviously!
…Why would they target Gamers,\nnyo?
Who shows up is a surprise!\nAnd that was your hot tip!\nBye-bye~!
Hey!? That's it!?
Mie's behavior: incomprehensible.
Kei vanished too!
What the hell! What are those guys even after?!
They probably haven't thought it through. Without a doubt.
So it's all just spur-of-the-moment?
At the very least, they don't seem\nto have anything like ideals or convictions.
The black ones - you called them the Dark Army?\nWhat of them?
Up until now, they've rarely shown\nany clear will of their own…
The black me is trying to kill me.\nThat much is certain.
The black Twin Angel holds\nthe 'Angel's Tear.'\nShe is most likely after 'Gustave.'
The black Rika is after Oyashiro-sama's power\nin Hinamizawa.\nI must face her myself.
Hinamizawa, Black Fund HQ,\nand Gamers.\nWe should split into three teams too.
Alright, then - everyone figure out\nwhere you're going!
Have we more or less decided, I wonder?
The Hinamizawa team: me, Shion, Rika-chan,\nSatoko, Rena, Houki, Cecilia, Rin, Charlotte,\nLaura, Tsubasa. Club members and IS pilots at the core.
The Gamers team: Dejiko, Puchiko, Usada,\nLouise, Tifa, Siesta, Soniko,\nChris, and Jeanne, nyo.
The Black Fund team: me, Remu, Shirayuki,\nReki, Kurumi, Haruka, Aoi, Hibiki, and Koto.
And the usual leftover -\nwhere's [CLAUDE]\nheaded?
'Leftover'… well, I can't argue with that.
'Leftover'… hey,\nI'm getting treated like a leftover tooo!
I'm [CLAUDE]'s support, so\nit can't be helped, but… yeaaah,\nguess I'm a leftover too…
Sorry as always…
Then it's settled.
Rikorin's fine with the leftover team, yon.\nThey say leftovers bring good fortune~!
Don't go doing anything unnecessary.
I'll behave myself until I get my rosary back,\npromise.
What about Yase?
I'll stick with the leftover bunch.\nThat boy there looks unreliable, after all.
I-I'm sorry! Sorry!
What will Tesla-chan and Nine-chan do?
We're going to stop Gustave.
I agree. With sis.
What will Tesla-chan and Nine-chan do?
I can't ignore Gustave.\nBut please let me think about whether to fight.
Big sis…
If you haven't sorted out your feelings,\ndon't push yourself.
I'm sorry…
We still have little information,\nso we don't know what awaits us on site.\nCaution is required.
If trouble comes up, report in from Dokoka Town.
Feels like we're back to groping in the dark like the early days.
Thinking about it now, it's a wonder\nwe managed so well while fumbling in the dark.
Isn't it 'cause everyone's strong?
You say that so casually. Honestly.
Anyway, let's all work together and do our best!
Yeah!
Yes!
Mm.
Alright!
Let's do this!
Deploy!
Moving out!
Moving out, nyo!
//END
